name: Mistral Vibe
description: Mistral's open-source command-line coding assistant for exploring and modifying a codebase in natural language.
whatItDoes: Vibe offers a conversational terminal interface for reading, searching and editing project files and running commands, plus a programmatic mode for scripted runs with turn and cost limits.
howItWorks: A Python CLI runs an agent loop on Mistral models with file, search, shell and question-asking tools and configurable agent profiles such as a plan mode. MCP servers can be added and tool calls are subject to approval.
